findings.title: Same-named operation classes from /encryption and /dynamodb confuse consumers' type annotations
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Both entry points now export distinct same-named classes (dynamodb EncryptModelOperation extends DynamoDBOperation with private fields), so they are non-assignable and confusable; this is a naming hazard introduced by the new exports.

findings.title: Operation constructors become a semver-bound contract
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same accurate point: value re-exports make constructors and class identity public surface in a minor release; the cited lines confirm value export and type-only new imports.

findings.title: WithLockContext variants lose @internal despite the changeset saying they stay internal
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The @internal tags on the WithLockContext classes were removed while the changeset says they stay internal, but they are not exported, so this is only a doc-comment inconsistency (and no other WithLockContext class carries @internal either).
